Rekening koran = staging; mengisinya tid: Bank statement = staging; entering it creates no journal
Untuk rekening bank yang rekonsiliasinya: For bank accounts with reconciliation enabled, supplier payments are booked to "Outstanding Payments" and customer receipts to "Outstanding Receipts" — not yet to the bank account. When the transaction appears on the bank statement and is matched, the system creates a NEW clearing journal (transit account ↔ bank) dated on the statement line; the original payment journal is not changed. Movements booked directly to the bank (Cash & Bank Transactions, tax payments) are simply marked as matched. New items from the statement (bank fees, interest) are recorded via Cash & Bank Transactions, then matched.
Belum ada rekening bank yang rekonsilias: No bank account has reconciliation enabled yet. Enable it in Cash & Bank (edit the account → "Bank reconciliation").
